verses.ar: اَلْحِكْمَةُ بَنَتْ بَيْتَهَا. نَحَتَتْ أَعْمِدَتَهَا ٱلسَّبْعَةَ.
verses.kjv: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.web: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

verses.ar: ذَبَحَتْ ذَبْحَهَا. مَزَجَتْ خَمْرَهَا. أَيْضًا رَتَّبَتْ مَائِدَتَهَا.
verses.kjv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.web: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

verses.ar: أَرْسَلَتْ جَوَارِيَهَا تُنَادِي عَلَى ظُهُورِ أَعَالِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ:
verses.kjv: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.web: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

verses.ar: «مَنْ هُوَ جَاهِلٌ فَلْيَمِلْ إِلَى هُنَا». وَٱلنَّاقِصُ ٱلْفَهْمِ قَالَتْ لَهُ:
verses.kjv: Whoso [is] simple, let him turn in hither: [as for] him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

verses.ar: «هَلُمُّوا كُلُوا مِنْ طَعَامِي، وَٱشْرَبُوا مِنَ ٱلْخَمْرِ ٱلَّتِي مَزَجْتُهَا.
verses.kjv: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine [which] I have mingled.
verses.web: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

verses.ar: اُتْرُكُوا ٱلْجَهَالَاتِ فَتَحْيَوْا، وَسِيرُوا فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلْفَهْمِ».
verses.kjv: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.web: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

verses.ar: مَنْ يُوَبِّخْ مُسْتَهْزِئًا يَكْسَبْ لِنَفْسِهِ هَوَانًا، وَمَنْ يُنْذِرْ شِرِّيرًا يَكْسَبْ عَيْبًا.
verses.kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked [man getteth] himself a blot.
verses.web: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

verses.ar: لَا تُوَبِّخْ مُسْتَهْزِئًا لِئَلَّا يُبْغِضَكَ. وَبِّخْ حَكِيمًا فَيُحِبَّكَ.
verses.kjv: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.web: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

verses.ar: أَعْطِ حَكِيمًا فَيَكُونَ أَوْفَرَ حِكْمَةً. عَلِّمْ صِدِّيقًا فَيَزْدَادَ عِلْمًا.
verses.kjv: Give [instruction] to a wise [man], and he will be yet wiser: teach a just [man], and he will increase in learning.
verses.web: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

verses.ar: بَدْءُ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَمَعْرِفَةُ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ فَهْمٌ.
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy [is] understanding.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ بِي تَكْثُرُ أَيَّامُكَ وَتَزْدَادُ لَكَ سِنُو حَيَاةٍ.
verses.kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.web: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتَ حَكِيمًا فَأَنْتَ حَكِيمٌ لِنَفْسِكَ، وَإِنِ ٱسْتَهْزَأْتَ فَأَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ تَتَحَمَّلُ.
verses.kjv: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but [if] thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear [it].
verses.web: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

verses.ar: اَلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلْجَاهِلَةُ صَخَّابَةٌ حَمْقَاءُ وَلَا تَدْرِي شَيْئًا،
verses.kjv: ¶ A foolish woman [is] clamorous: [she is] simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.web: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

verses.ar: فَتَقْعُدُ عِنْدَ بَابِ بَيْتِهَا عَلَى كُرْسِيٍّ فِي أَعَالِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ،
verses.kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.web: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

verses.kjv: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.web: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

verses.ar: «مَنْ هُوَ جَاهِلٌ فَلْيَمِلْ إِلَى هُنَا». وَٱلنَّاقِصُ ٱلْفَهْمِ تَقُولُ لَهُ:
verses.kjv: Whoso [is] simple, let him turn in hither: and [as for] him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.web: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

verses.kjv: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant.
verses.web: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

verses.ar: وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ ٱلْأَخْيِلَةَ هُنَاكَ، وَأَنَّ فِي أَعْمَاقِ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ ضُيُوفَهَا.
verses.kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead [are] there; [and that] her guests [are] in the depths of hell.
verses.web: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
